issues.detail: The Vietnamese text includes 'hãy được khích lệ' (be encouraged), which has no equivalent in the Greek text (λοιπոն αδελφοι χαιρετε καταρτιζεσθε παρακαλεισθε το αυτο φρονειτε ειρηνευετε).

The Vietnamese 'hãy vui mừng' (be joyful/rejoice) for 'χαιρετε' is acceptable, but the phrase 'hãy được sửa lại' for 'καταρτιζεσθε' (be built up/edified) misses the specific nuance of spiritual construction/edification, though it is a common rendering. However, the addition of 'khích lệ' is the primary fidelity issue.
